glosses: face; side (of a sheet of paper)

examples.text: Se creía que la tierra era plana.
examples.en: It was believed that the earth was flat.

examples.text: La cima de la montaña es plana.
examples.en: The top of that mountain is flat.

examples.text: Este niño cree que la Tierra es plana.
examples.en: This child believes that the earth is flat.

examples.text: Algunas personas todavía piensan que la tierra es plana.
examples.en: Some people still believe that the world is flat.
